categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Huiyu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of anti-tumor innovative drugs and high-quality generic drugs, focusing on injectable formulations. The company also provides CDMO services covering drug development, raw material and formulation production, and international registration and sales. Additionally, it develops medical devices mainly in injection forms for consumer healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technology platforms including dual-target small molecule drug design, three-antibody and ADC biologics platforms, and complex injectable formulation technologies. It maintains rigorous quality management systems compliant with Chinese, EU, and US GMP standards. Production methods emphasize standardized, procedural, and systematized manufacturing with continuous process optimization and cost control, including low-temperature automated production and advanced impurity control techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, especially tiered hospitals in China, served mainly through volume-based procurement and academic promotion channels. Internationally, sales are conducted via subsidiaries and distributors in Europe, North America, and emerging markets covering over 70 countries. Key customers include large state-owned pharmaceutical distributors such as Sinopharm Holdings and China Resources Pharmaceutical.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production bases in Sichuan Province. It has an expanding international presence through subsidiaries and partnerships in Europe (UK, Germany, Italy, France, Spain, Portugal, Netherlands, Nordic and Eastern Europe), North America (USA, Canada), and emerging markets across Asia, Oceania, and Africa, covering 42 countries and regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huiyu Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, encompassing drug R&D, raw material production, formulation manufacturing, and sales distribution. It also extends upstream by producing active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) for its formulations, enabling integrated raw material and drug production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on innovation-driven growth, accelerating the development of first-in-class and improved new drugs, particularly in oncology. It emphasizes dual-target small molecule drugs, biologics including ADCs, and complex injectable generics. R&D efforts also target high-barrier generics and complex formulations, with plans to increase AI integration in R&D, production, supply chain, and customer service. International registration and commercialization of innovative drugs are key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of anti-tumor and other injectable drugs domestically and internationally. The company also earns income from technical service fees related to drug formulation and process development. Sales channels include direct sales, distribution agreements, and consignment sales, with significant reliance on government-led volume-based procurement programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huiyu Pharmaceutical is positioned as a leading domestic oncology-focused pharmaceutical company with a strong presence in injectable generics and innovative drugs. It competes with major domestic players like Jiangsu Hengrui Medicine and Qilu Pharmaceutical, as well as international pharmaceutical companies. The company ranks among the top 100 Chinese chemical drug enterprises and leads in oncology injectable generics registration in Europe.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, an 18.05% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 325 million, up 132.78%. Total assets reached RMB 5.17 billion, growing 10.24%, with net assets of RMB 3.98 billion. R&D investment accounted for 31.64% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation. The company maintains positive cash flow and has steadily expanded its international sales, which nearly doubled in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huiyu Pharmaceutical emphasizes providing effective, high-quality, and reasonably priced oncology drugs to make cancer a manageable chronic disease. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated R&D and production capabilities, advanced technology platforms for innovative and complex injectable drugs, and compliance with international quality standards. The company’s extensive product pipeline, including first-in-class dual-target drugs and improved formulations, alongside a robust international registration and sales network, underpins its unique value proposition.
